info.title: AuraBrain Tenant API
info.description:
Programmatic API for tenant IoT device management.

## Authentication
Use one of the following:
- **Basic Auth**: `Authorization: Basic {Base64(ClientId:ClientSecret)}`
- **Bearer Token**: `Authorization: Bearer {ClientId:ClientSecret}`
- **Custom Headers**: `X-Client-Id` and `X-Client-Secret`

## Client-Based Endpoints
The recommended way to access devices is through **client-scoped endpoints**:
- `POST /api/v1/clients/resolve` — Resolve a client by email/phone (read-only)
- `POST /api/v1/clients/createClient` — Create a client (OTP-verified, no password)
- `POST /api/v1/clients/createClient/verify` — Verify client creation OTP
- `GET /api/v1/clients` — List all clients under your tenant
- `GET /api/v1/clients/{id}` — Get client details
- `GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/devices` — List devices for a client
- `GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/devices/{deviceId}` — Get device state
- `POST /api/v1/clients/{id}/devices/{deviceId}/command` — Send command
- `GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes` — List homes for a client
- `GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}` — Get home details with floors
- `GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}/floors` — List floors in a home
- `GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}/floors/{floorId}/rooms` — List rooms in a floor
- `POST /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes` — Create a home
- `PUT /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}` — Update a home
- `DELETE /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}` — Delete a home
- `POST /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}/floors` — Create a floor
- `PUT /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}/floors/{floorId}` — Update a floor
- `DELETE /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}/floors/{floorId}` — Delete a floor
- `POST /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}/floors/{floorId}/rooms` — Create a room
- `PUT /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}/floors/{floorId}/rooms/{roomId}` — Update a room
- `DELETE /api/v1/clients/{id}/homes/{homeId}/floors/{floorId}/rooms/{roomId}` — Delete a room

Device responses include `room`, `floor`, `home`, `client_id`, and `client_name` fields.

## Device Commands
Send commands via `POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/command` with body:
```json
{"command": "on", "value": null}
```
Supported commands:
- `on` / `off`: Turn device on or off
- `toggle`: Toggle between on and off
- `brightness`: Set brightness level (value: 0–100)
- `temperature`: Set target temperature (value: "22")
- `speed`: Set fan speed (value: "1", "2", "3")
- `color`: Set light color (value: "#FF5733")
- `set`: Set raw state string (value: "any value")

## Rate Limiting
Requests are rate-limited based on your subscription package.

## Permission Levels
- `read`: View devices, homes, and state (GET only)
- `read_write`: Full control including sending commands

post.summary:
Issue a short-lived, single-use SSO token for App-to-App Alexa account linking.
The caller's identity (user, client, tenant) is taken from the platform JWT claims.

200.description: Single-use SSO token + ready-to-open authorize URL.

401.description: Missing or invalid platform JWT / client identity.

post.summary:
Exchange a Client ID + Client Secret for a short-lived JWT (API access).
This is the only way to authenticate to the Tenant API — direct ClientId:Secret is not accepted.
post.description:
Always returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body — `{ success, token, expiresAt, ... }` on success,
or `{ success: false, error }` when the Client ID / secret / subscription is invalid.

200.description: JWT token on success, or an error payload.

get.summary:
List all automations for the authenticated client.
Automations group device actions (on/off/brightness/speed) that run on a schedule or on demand.

post.summary: Create a new automation for the authenticated client with a trigger and one or more device actions.

get.summary: Get a single automation by its ID, including its trigger and device actions.

put.summary: Update an automation's name, trigger, or device actions. Returns the updated automation.

post.summary:
Enable or disable an automation without changing its trigger or actions.
Client-owner only: SuperAdmin/Tenant (read-only roles) are rejected 403 by [RequireDeviceOwner],
and the owning-Client check forbids a Client toggling another client's automation.

403.description: Not the owning client / read-only role.

get.summary:
GET /api/v1/clients/{clientId}/homes/{homeId}/dashboard?period=daily
period ∈ hourly | daily | weekly | monthly (default: daily).

post.summary:
Create a client via OTP verification. NO password is accepted or provisioned by the caller.
A pending client + inactive login account are created, an OTP is delivered to the contact
(email or SMS), and the client becomes active only after OTP verification.

Verify the OTP for a pending client creation. On success the client + login account
become active. Credentials are established by the user's chosen auth mode afterwards
(Email + Password via existing password-setup, or Email/Phone OTP).

404.description: Client or login account not found.

post.summary:
Initiate a client password reset. The Tenant (owning the client) triggers an OTP email to
the client's address. NO password is accepted from the Tenant API — the client completes
the reset with the OTP + their own new password via the verify endpoint.

400.description: Client has no email for OTP delivery.

404.description: Client or login account not found.

post.summary:
Complete a client password reset. Requires the OTP (sent via the initiate endpoint) and
the client's OWN new password — the Tenant API never supplies the password.

404.description: Client or login account not found.

post.summary:
Trigger a vendor-neutral device synchronization for a client's vendor account.
The client's VendorAccount is resolved server-side from the authenticated tenant scope —
never from an arbitrary VendorAccountId in the request.

get.summary: List all clients for the authenticated tenant, including their home and device counts.
Get details of a specific client: device/online counts and the active home's timezone.

List all devices for a specific client.
Optional query filters: `homeId` and `roomId`.
Get the current state of a single device within a client (online, state, brightness, last updated).

put.summary: Update a device's name. Only the name is changed (type, room, and state are untouched).

delete.summary: Permanently delete a device, including its state and energy history.

post.summary:
Send a command to a device within a client.
Requires 'read_write' permission level.
post.description:
Supported commands: `on` / `off` / `toggle` / `brightness` (0–100) /
`temperature` / `speed` / `color` / `set`.
Fan speed: `{"command":"speed","value":"2"}` — always turns the device ON and sets the
normalized speed (1..N). The speed is vendor-neutral; the vendor Skill owns any translation
(e.g. Tinxy brightness 33/66/100).

get.summary: List all homes for a specific client, each with its floor/room/device counts.

post.summary: Create a new home for a client, with an optional address and coordinates.

get.summary: Get a single home for a client with its floor/room/device counts.

put.summary: Update a home's name, address, or coordinates. Only provided fields are changed.

delete.summary: Permanently delete a home and all of its floors, rooms, and devices.

get.summary: List all floors in a home, each with its room and device counts.

post.summary: Create a new floor in a home, with an optional floor number (used for ordering).

get.summary: List all rooms in a floor, each including its devices (id, name, type, online, state).

404.description: Client, home, or floor not found.

post.summary: Create a new room in a floor.

404.description: Client, home, or floor not found.

put.summary: Update a floor's name or number. Only provided fields are changed.

404.description: Client, home, or floor not found.

delete.summary: Permanently delete a floor and all of its rooms and devices.

404.description: Client, home, or floor not found.
Client, home, floor, or room not found.

delete.summary: Permanently delete a room and its devices.

404.description: Client, home, floor, or room not found.

post.summary:
Move a device to a different room or floor.
Provide either `room_id` or `floor_id` (mutually exclusive).

404.description: Client, device, room, or floor not found.

get.summary:
Astronomical solar status for a home's registered lat/lon: sunrise, solar noon,
sunset (ISO-8601 UTC) + current sun position state (Day/Night/Dusk/Dawn).
Read the client-facing Dusk-to-Dawn setting for a home.

put.summary: Create/update the client-facing Dusk-to-Dawn setting for a home (client-owned scene).

get.summary:
Phase 3 — Contextual Weather-Driven Smart Prompts. Evaluates local temperature, humidity,
and rain conditions and returns non-intrusive prompt cards (heatwave pre-cooling, rain /
monsoon outdoor check). Rule evaluation is backend-owned; UIs render + dismiss only.

post.summary:
Phase 4 — Update and persist the home's exact location + geofence + Home Wi-Fi SSID.
Client-facing: the mobile "Sync Current Location as Home" button posts native GPS here.

Phase 4 — Report a family member's presence (Wi-Fi + GPS hybrid). The backend evaluates
whether the member is HOME and re-aggregates the overall Home State. Members are matched
by id (or by the authenticated user's email when id is omitted).

get.summary: Phase 4 — Aggregate family presence for a home (Home State + member statuses).

Phase 4 — Native lockscreen widget quick-action config: list favorite scenes the user can
trigger from iOS WidgetKit / Android App Widgets. Scene activation reuses the existing
POST /api/v1/scenes/{id}/activate client-facing endpoint.

List all scenes for the authenticated client.
A scene is a one-tap group of device actions (on/off/brightness/speed).

post.summary: Create a new scene for the authenticated client with one or more device actions.

get.summary: Get a single scene by its ID, including its device actions.

put.summary: Update a scene's name or its device actions.

post.summary:
Activate a scene — sends all of its device commands immediately.
Client-owner only: SuperAdmin/Tenant (read-only roles) are rejected 403 by [RequireDeviceOwner],
and the owning-Client check forbids a Client activating another client's scene.

403.description: Not the owning client / read-only role.

get.summary:
Phase 3 — Real-time sequential scene execution progress: current step, total steps,
and percentage complete. Idle scenes return a deterministic 0/0 idle shape.

ClientDashboardResponse.description:
Public V1 Client Dashboard response DTO. Returns everything the client/mobile app
needs to render the dashboard without duplicating any energy calculation.

value.description: Command value (e.g. brightness 0–100, fan speed "1".."3", color "#FF5733").

ReportPresenceRequest.description: Phase 4 — family presence report (Wi-Fi and/or GPS hybrid).

SetDuskDawnRequest.description: Request body for the Dusk-to-Dawn setting.

SetHomeLocationRequest.description: Phase 4 — home location sync request (lat/lon + geofence radius + Wi-Fi SSID).

JwtBearer.description:
Enter your JWT token.

- **Web/Mobile users**: obtain one from `POST /api/auth/login` (email + password)
- **API clients**: obtain one from `POST /api/auth/token` (Client ID + Client Secret)

Paste just the token, **without** `Bearer ` prefix.
